page.layout: One page of text in a single full-width column of dictionary entries, Latin with Hebrew. Running head centred at top. Page number at top left. Catchword at right below the last line. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: v.3.6. Item Obolus, quasi minimum moneta Segmentum, Exod.30.13. quorum viginti faciebant siclum.
גָּרוֹן m. Guttur, ab Interfectionibus, vel ab Attractione spiritus: נְטוּיוֹת גָּרוֹן Extenta gutture, Jefa.3.16. Aff. גְּרוֹנִי Guttur meum, Psal.69.4. Est forma חִלּוֹן.
אֲגוֹרָה f. Numulus: Constr. לַאֲגוֹרַת כֶּסֶף Pro numulo argenteo, 1.Sam.2.36. ubi Kimchi notat, א esse servile, & ejusdem originis cum גְּרָה: de quo ante.
גַּרְגַּר m. Granum; Bacca: Plural. גַּרְגְּרִים; Jefa.17.6.
גַּרְגְּרוֹת · גַּרְגֶּרֶת f. Faux; Fistula gutturis, a Segmentis & orbibus, ut R.Salom. scribit: Plural. עַל גַּרְגְּרוֹתֶיךָ Ad fauces tuas, Prov.3.3.
מִגְרָה f. Serra, 1.Reg.7.9. 2.Sam.12.31. Plur. וּבְמִגְרוֹת Et serris, 1.Par.20.3. pro quo legitur 2.Sam.12.31. וּבְמִגְזְרוֹת Et fecuribus.

גָּרַשׁ Expulit, Ejecit: Partic. praesens, גֹּרֵשׁ מִפָּנֶיךָ Expulsurus sum à facie tua, Exod.34.11. Particip. praeteritum, וּגְרוּשָׁה Et expulsam, id est, repudiatam, Levit.21.14. Niph. Praeter. נִגְרַשְׁתִּי Ejectus sum, Jon.2.5. Particip. גָּרוּשׁ Expulsum, Propulsum, Jefa.57.20. Pih. Praeter. גֵּרַשְׁתָּ Expulsisti, Genef.4.14. Infinit. גָּרֹשׁ יִגְרֹשׁ Expellendo expellet, Exod.11.1. Pyh. Praeter. גֹּרְשׁוּ Expulsi sunt, Exod.12.39.
גֶּרֶשׁ m. Ejectum, Extrusum; גֶּרֶשׁ יְרָחִים Extrusum lunarum, id est, Fructus quos quaeq; luna protrudit, Deuter.33.14.

מִגְרָשׁ m. Expulsio, Suburbium, Suburbanum praedium, Ezech.45. v.2. dictum, quasi ex urbe Expulsum: Constr. מִגְרַשׁ Lev.25.34. Aff. לְמַעַן מִגְרַשָּׁהּ Propter expulsionem ejus, Ezech.36.5. Plur. Constr. מִגְרְשֵׁי הָעָרִים Suburbana praedia civitatum, Num.35.4.5. Aff. וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶם Et suburbana pradia illarum, v.3. וּמִגְרָשָׁה Et suburbana

page.notes: Catchword "pradia" at the right foot is the first word of the next page. Printed "fecuribus" in the entry מִגְרָה is a printing error for "securibus" (the Hebrew at its side reads וּבְמִגְזְרוֹת); left as printed. Printed "quaeq;" left as printed. "Interfectionibus" is printed as shown. Pointing of the Hebrew forms is copied as far as legible; some vowel points in the entries are faint and may be imperfectly rendered. The final Hebrew word of the page (וּמִגְרָשָׁה) and its Latin line are at the limit of legibility.
